proof_attempt_summary: D0 produced a profiled masked-FE projection, a sharp one-opportunity Gaussian selection geometry, stationary zero-placebo/nonzero-bias witnesses, and a local multicohort extension. The cited iid Wald substrate was verified from the publisher preview and the D0.5 math panel passed, but the package panel remained at revise and graded the result incremental, below the field floor. The pinned fect comparison, related-work positioning, package repairs, and all Lean formalization remain undone; this archive is not a clean lower-tier acceptance.
tldr: The project gives a mask-uniform, estimator-specific audit of additive FEct placebos formed by withholding any nondegenerate consecutive pretreatment window from one common two-way fit. For every one-opportunity window and fixed adopter share, it derives computable profiled rows, necessary-and-sufficient rank or minor conditions for separating zero held-out leads from horizon bias, and the exact sharp attainable bias interval over the simultaneous-zero-lead family. If \(V_0\) spans \(\ker A_L\), \(Q=V_0'\Sigma_gV_0\), \(c_0=A_B(h)V_0\), and \(K=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(1-p))/\{p(1-p)\}\), that interval is \(\{0\}\) when \(c_0=0\) and otherwise \((-K\sqrt{c_0Q^{-1}c_0'},K\sqrt{c_0Q^{-1}c_0'})\), with sharp but unattained endpoints. The documented specialization fixes \(C=\{4\}\) and \(w^{\mathrm{doc}}_4=3\), retains date \(0\), holds out dates \(1,2,3\), and supplies exact stationary witnesses. Only for that documented mask, complete-history risk-set forecasts identify the missing counterfactual bias and support joint pointwise Wald inference. The result does not assert a universal timing criterion, nonidentification, or a generic warning about pretrends.
gap: The FEct literature documents held-out diagnostics, Li--Strezhnev explains fixed baselines and alternative imputation-placebo comparisons, and Bonhomme supplies the affine feedback mechanism. These sources do not give a window-uniform population operator or a computable rank characterization of the lawful Gaussian index families separating all held-out leads from same-fit horizon bias.
fill: The paper profiles every prefix-window fit into explicit rows, proves rank and determinant criteria for relatively open dense quiet-placebo and converse index families, and specializes them to \(C=\{4\}\), \(w^{\mathrm{doc}}_4=3\), retained baseline date \(0\), and held-out dates \(1,2,3\) with exact stationary witnesses. Complete-history joint inference is a supporting result only for this documented-mask specialization.
